name: Google Scholar
note: Find scholarly literature, follow citation trails, and discover related research across disciplines.

name: arXiv
note: Explore research preprints and follow new work in physics, mathematics, computer science, and related fields.

name: GitHub
note: Explore source code, document research software, and collaborate on reproducible scientific projects.

name: Overleaf
note: Write and revise LaTeX documents in a shared editor, with a live preview of the manuscript.

name: Copernicus CDS
note: Access climate datasets, tools, and documentation from the Copernicus Climate Change Service.

name: ChatGPT
note: Explore ideas, work through questions, and develop early drafts. Check important results against original sources.

name: Claude
note: Read and discuss documents, develop ideas, and work on writing and coding tasks.

name: Gemini
note: Explore ideas, ask questions, and get help with writing, learning, and everyday tasks.

name: DeepSeek
note: Work through questions, explore ideas, and get help with writing and coding.

name: LaTeX Previewer
note: Preview LaTeX snippets with optional packages and export the results as PDF, SVG, or PNG.

name: IPCC AR6 WGI Interactive Atlas
note: Explore spatial and temporal patterns of observed and projected climate change with the IPCC interactive atlas.

name: NASA Worldview
note: Browse global satellite imagery, investigate changes over time, and find the underlying data for further analysis.

name: ERA5
note: Find information about ERA5, a global reanalysis of atmospheric, land, and oceanic climate variables.

name: CMIP
note: Learn about coordinated climate model experiments and comparisons of past and future climate change.

name: DCENT-I
note: Explore monthly global surface temperature data from 1850 onward.

name: Zoom Earth
note: Explore global weather satellite imagery and follow cloud patterns using interactive maps.

name: Nature
note: Explore research, reviews, and news across the natural sciences.

name: Nature Climate Change
note: Read research on climate change, its impacts, and responses across science and society.

name: Nature Geoscience
note: Explore research on Earth systems, geoscience, and planetary processes.

name: Nature Ecology & Evolution
note: Read research on ecology, biodiversity, and evolutionary processes.

name: Nature Communications
note: Explore open-access research across the natural sciences.

name: Science
note: Browse research, perspectives, and news across scientific disciplines.

name: Science Advances
note: Read open-access research across science, engineering, and related fields.

name: PNAS
note: Explore research spanning the biological, physical, and social sciences.

name: Physical Review Letters
note: Read concise reports of significant advances across physics.
